```{r}
set.seed(123)

f_Xt = function(n_vec){
  #readline("missing days must be represented with zeros not NA's")
  X_t = matrix(0, 
               nrow = sum(n_vec), 
               ncol = length(n_vec))
  trackrow = 1
  for (i in 1:length(n_vec)){
      if(n_vec[i] > 0){
        X_t[trackrow:(trackrow + n_vec[i] - 1), i] = 1
        trackrow = trackrow + n_vec[i]
      }
  }
  return(X_t)
}

f_Xt_sparse = function(n_vec){
  #readline("missing days must be represented with zeros not NA's")

  T <- length(n_vec)
  total_rows <- sum(n_vec)

  # Column index for each row
  j <- rep(seq_len(T), times = n_vec)

  # Row index
  i <- seq_len(total_rows)

  # Values (all ones)
  x <- rep(1, total_rows)

  sparseMatrix(
    i = i,
    j = j,
    x = x,
    dims = c(total_rows, T)
  )
}

conf_region_2d <- function(alpha = .05, 
                           theta_hat, 
                           theta_true, 
                           Sigma,           
                           n_points = 200,
                           level_label = TRUE
                           ) {
  stopifnot(
    length(theta_hat) == 2,
    is.matrix(Sigma),
    all(dim(Sigma) == c(2, 2))
  )

  # Chi-square cutoff
  r2 <- qchisq(alpha, df = 3)

  # Eigen decomposition
  eig <- eigen(Sigma)
  A <- eig$vectors %*% diag(sqrt(eig$values))

  # Parametric circle
  t <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n_points)
  circle <- rbind(cos(t), sin(t))

  # Ellipse
  ellipse <- t(theta_hat + sqrt(r2) * A %*% circle)

  df_ellipse <- data.frame(
    x = ellipse[, 1],
    y = ellipse[, 2]
  )

  df_point <- data.frame(
    x = theta_hat[1],
    y = theta_hat[2]
  )



  p <- ggplot(df_ellipse, aes(x, y)) +
    geom_path(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(data = df_point, aes(x, y), size = 3, col = "red") +
    geom_point(data = tibble(x = theta_true[1], y = theta_true[2]), mapping = aes(x,y), col = "blue") +
    coord_equal() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      x = expression(theta[1]),
      y = expression(theta[2]),
      title = if (level_label)
        paste0(round(alpha * 100), "% Confidence Region")
      else NULL
    )

  return(p)
}

simulate_and_plot_conf_o <- function(phi, theta, var_eta, TT, sims,
                                     var_eps, nn, alpha = 0.05,
                                     ngrid = 40) {
  
  # --- Step 1: compute theoretical covariance ---
  theta_b = fwd(phi, theta, var_eta, var_eps, nn)[1]
  var_b = fwd(phi, theta, var_eta, var_eps, nn)[2]
  
  Sigma_inv = solve(Sigma_o(ar = phi, ma_b = theta_b,
                            veps = var_eps, v_b = var_b, n = nn)[1:3,1:3])
  true_vec = c(phi, theta_b, var_b)
  chi_q = qchisq(1 - alpha, df = 3)
  
  # --- Step 2: simulate estimates ---
  est_matrix = matrix(NA, nrow = sims, ncol = 3)
  inside = logical(sims)
  
  for (sim in 1:sims) {
    # ARMA simulation
    test_u = arima.sim(model = list(ar = phi, ma = theta), sd = sqrt(var_eta), n = TT)
    eps = rnorm(n = TT * nn, mean = 0, sd = sqrt(var_eps))
    
    # Averaging over daily observations
    y = rep(test_u, each = nn) + eps
    w = t(matrix(y, nrow = nn)) %*% rep(1/nn, nn)
    
    # Variance estimation
    x = y - rep(w, each = nn)
    var_eps_hat = sum(x ^ 2) / ((nn - 1) * TT)
    
    # ARMA fit
    arma_noise = arima(w, order = c(1,0,1), include.mean = FALSE)
    phi_hat = arma_noise$coef["ar1"]
    theta_b_hat = arma_noise$coef["ma1"]
    var_b_hat = arma_noise$sigma2
    
    # Store vector
    est_vec = c(phi_hat, theta_b_hat, var_b_hat)
    est_matrix[sim, ] = est_vec
    
    # Chi-square check
    chi_stat = t(est_vec - true_vec) %*% Sigma_inv %*% (est_vec - true_vec) * TT
    inside[sim] = chi_stat < chi_q
  }
  
  # --- Step 3: compute confidence ellipsoid grid ---
  Sigma = solve(Sigma_inv) / TT
  r2 = qchisq(1 - alpha, df = 3)
  eig = eigen(Sigma)
  A = eig$vectors %*% diag(sqrt(eig$values * r2))
  
  # Sphere parameterization
  u = seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = ngrid)
  v = seq(0, pi, length.out = ngrid)
  x = outer(cos(u), sin(v))
  y = outer(sin(u), sin(v))
  z = outer(rep(1, length(u)), cos(v))
  
  ellipsoid = A %*% rbind(as.vector(x), as.vector(y), as.vector(z))
  x_e = matrix(ellipsoid[1, ] + true_vec[1], ngrid, ngrid)
  y_e = matrix(ellipsoid[2, ] + true_vec[2], ngrid, ngrid)
  z_e = matrix(ellipsoid[3, ] + true_vec[3], ngrid, ngrid)
  
  # --- Step 4: generate plot ---
  p <- plot_ly() %>%
    add_surface(
      x = x_e, y = y_e, z = z_e,
      opacity = 0.5,
      name = paste0(round(100*(1-alpha)), "% confidence ellipsoid"),
      showscale = FALSE
    ) %>%
    add_markers(
      x = est_matrix[,1],
      y = est_matrix[,2],
      z = est_matrix[,3],
      color = ~inside,
      colors = c("red", "green"),
      marker = list(size = 3),
      name = "Simulations (green = inside)"
    ) %>%
    add_markers(
      x = true_vec[1], y = true_vec[2], z = true_vec[3],
      marker = list(size = 5, color = "blue"),
      name = "True value"
    ) %>%
    layout(
      scene = list(
        xaxis = list(title = "phi"),
        yaxis = list(title = "theta_b"),
        zaxis = list(title = "var_b")
      ),
      title = paste0(round(100*(1-alpha)), "% Confidence Ellipsoid with Simulations")
    )
  
  return(p)
}

simulate_and_plot_conf_l <- function(phi, 
                                     theta, 
                                     var_eta, 
                                     TT, 
                                     sims,
                                     var_eps, 
                                     nn, 
                                     alpha = 0.05,
                                     ngrid = 40) {
  
  # --- Step 1: compute theoretical covariance ---
  theta_b = fwd(phi, theta, var_eta, var_eps, nn)[1]
  var_b = fwd(phi, theta, var_eta, var_eps, nn)[2]
  true_vec = c(phi,theta,var_eta)
  S_o = Sigma_o(ar = phi, ma_b = theta_b,
                            veps = var_eps, v_b = var_b, n = nn)
  dHdtau0 = dHf_dtau0(phi, theta_b, var_eps/n, var_b)
  dHdtau1 = dHf_dtau1(theta,var_eta)
  GGG = -solve(dHdtau1) %*% dHdtau0
  S_f = GGG %*% S_o %*% t(GGG)
  S_l = S_f[c(1,5,6), c(1,5,6)]
  Sigma = S_l
  chi_q = qchisq(1 - alpha, df = 3)
  
  # --- Step 2: simulate estimates ---
  est_matrix = matrix(NA, nrow = sims, ncol = 3)
  inside = logical(sims)
  
  for (sim in 1:sims) {
    # ARMA simulation
    test_u = arima.sim(model = list(ar = phi, ma = theta), sd = sqrt(var_eta), n = TT)
    eps = rnorm(n = TT * nn, mean = 0, sd = sqrt(var_eps))
    
    # Averaging over daily observations
    y = rep(test_u, each = nn) + eps
    w = t(matrix(y, nrow = nn)) %*% rep(1 / nn, nn)
    
    # Variance estimation
    x = y - rep(w, each = nn)
    var_eps_hat = sum(x ^ 2) / ((nn - 1) * TT)
    
    # ARMA fit
    arma_noise = arima(w, order = c(1,0,1), include.mean = FALSE)
    phi_hat = arma_noise$coef["ar1"]
    theta_b_hat = arma_noise$coef["ma1"]
    var_b_hat = arma_noise$sigma2
    wong_est = wong(ar_hat = phi_hat, 
                    ma_b_hat = theta_b_hat, 
                    v_b_hat = var_b_hat, 
                    veps_hat = var_eps_hat, 
                    n = nn)
    theta_hat = wong_est[1]
    var_eta_hat = wong_est[2]
    
    # Store vector
    est_vec = c(phi_hat, theta_hat, var_eta_hat)
    est_matrix[sim, ] = est_vec
    
    # Chi-square check
    chi_stat = t(est_vec - true_vec) %*% Sigma_inv %*% (est_vec - true_vec) * TT
    inside[sim] = chi_stat < chi_q
  }
  
  # --- Step 3: compute confidence ellipsoid grid ---
  Sigma =  Sigma / TT
  r2 = qchisq(1 - alpha, df = 3)
  eig = eigen(Sigma)
  A = eig$vectors %*% diag(sqrt(eig$values * r2))
  
  # Sphere parameterization
  u = seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = ngrid)
  v = seq(0, pi, length.out = ngrid)
  x = outer(cos(u), sin(v))
  y = outer(sin(u), sin(v))
  z = outer(rep(1, length(u)), cos(v))
  
  ellipsoid = A %*% rbind(as.vector(x), as.vector(y), as.vector(z))
  x_e = matrix(ellipsoid[1, ] + true_vec[1], ngrid, ngrid)
  y_e = matrix(ellipsoid[2, ] + true_vec[2], ngrid, ngrid)
  z_e = matrix(ellipsoid[3, ] + true_vec[3], ngrid, ngrid)
  
  # --- Step 4: generate plot ---
  p <- plot_ly() %>%
    add_surface(
      x = x_e, y = y_e, z = z_e,
      opacity = 0.5,
      name = paste0(round(100*(1-alpha)), "% confidence ellipsoid"),
      showscale = FALSE
    ) %>%
    add_markers(
      x = est_matrix[,1],
      y = est_matrix[,2],
      z = est_matrix[,3],
      color = ~inside,
      colors = c("red", "green"),
      marker = list(size = 3),
      name = "Simulations (green = inside)"
    ) %>%
    add_markers(
      x = true_vec[1], y = true_vec[2], z = true_vec[3],
      marker = list(size = 5, color = "blue"),
      name = "True value"
    ) %>%
    layout(
      scene = list(
        xaxis = list(title = "phi"),
        yaxis = list(title = "theta"),
        zaxis = list(title = "var_eta")
      ),
      title = paste0(round(100*(1-alpha)), "% Confidence Ellipsoid with Simulations")
    )
  
  return(p)
}

power_f = function(base, exponent){
    exponent = pmax(exponent, 0)
    return(base ^ exponent)
  }
  
  outer_function_G = function(x, y, ar_coef, ma_coef, vv){
    w = abs(x - y) 
    z = vv * (ar_coef + ma_coef + ar_coef * (ar_coef + ma_coef) ^ 2 / (1 - ar_coef ^ 2)) * power_f(ar_coef, w - 1)
    return(as.vector(z))
    #diag_G = var_eta_est * (1 + (phi_est + theta_est) ^ 2 / (1 - phi_est ^ 2))
    
  }
  
  fG = function(size, eta_variance, ar, ma){
    dd = eta_variance * (1 + (ar + ma) ^ 2 / (1 - ar ^ 2))
    z = outer(1:size, 1:size, FUN = function(x,y) outer_function_G(x,y, ar_coef = ar, ma_coef = ma, vv = eta_variance)) -  diag(outer_function_G(1,1, ar_coef = ar, ma_coef = ma, vv = eta_variance), size) + diag(dd, size)
    return(z)
  }
equations_arma <- function(vars, ph_hat, theta_b_hat, sigma_a2_hat, sigma_b2_hat) {
  th <- vars[1]
  sigma_eps2 <- vars[2]

  eq1 <- (1 + th^2) * sigma_eps2 + (1 + ph_hat^2) * sigma_a2_hat - (1 + theta_b_hat^2) * sigma_b2_hat
  eq2 <- th * sigma_eps2 - ph_hat * sigma_a2_hat - theta_b_hat * sigma_b2_hat

  return(eq1^2 + eq2^2)
}



plot_conf_ellipsoid_3d <- function(Sigma, mu, alpha = 0.05, ngrid = 40,
                                  plane_range = 3) {
  stopifnot(is.matrix(Sigma), nrow(Sigma) == 3, ncol(Sigma) == 3)
  stopifnot(length(mu) == 3)

  # Chi-square radius
  r2 <- qchisq(1 - alpha, df = 3)

  # Eigen-decomposition
  eig <- eigen(Sigma)
  A <- eig$vectors %*% diag(sqrt(eig$values * r2))

  # Sphere parameterization
  u <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = ngrid)
  v <- seq(0, pi, length.out = ngrid)

  x <- outer(cos(u), sin(v))
  y <- outer(sin(u), sin(v))
  z <- outer(rep(1, length(u)), cos(v))

  # Map unit sphere → ellipsoid
  ellipsoid <- A %*% rbind(as.vector(x),
                           as.vector(y),
                           as.vector(z))

  x_e <- matrix(ellipsoid[1, ] + mu[1], ngrid, ngrid)
  y_e <- matrix(ellipsoid[2, ] + mu[2], ngrid, ngrid)
  z_e <- matrix(ellipsoid[3, ] + mu[3], ngrid, ngrid)

  # Plane: x + y = 0  ⇒  y = -x
  xr <- seq(-plane_range, plane_range, length.out = ngrid)
  zr <- seq(-plane_range, plane_range, length.out = ngrid)

  x_p <- outer(xr, rep(1, ngrid))
  y_p <- -x_p
  z_p <- outer(rep(1, ngrid), zr)

  plot_ly() %>%
    add_surface(
      x = x_e, y = y_e, z = z_e,
      opacity = 0.6,
      name = "Confidence Ellipsoid",
      showscale = FALSE
    ) %>%
    add_surface(
      x = x_p, y = y_p, z = z_p,
      opacity = 0.25,
      surfacecolor = matrix(1, ngrid, ngrid),
      colorscale = list(c(0, "gray"), c(1, "gray")),
      name = "x + y = 0",
      showscale = FALSE
    ) %>%
    add_markers(
      x = mu[1], y = mu[2], z = mu[3],
      marker = list(size = 4),
      name = "Center"
    ) %>%
    layout(
      scene = list(
        xaxis = list(title = "phi"),
        yaxis = list(title = "theta"),
        zaxis = list(title = "sigma2")
      ),
      title = paste0("95% Confidence Ellipsoid with Plane x + y = 0")
    )
}



fwd = function(ar,ma,veta,veps,n){
  threshold = .000001
  if (abs(ar) < threshold && abs(ma) < threshold){

    return(c(0, veta + veps / n))
  }else if(abs(ma / ar - veps / n / veta) < threshold){
    new_ma = 0
    new_var = veta * (ar + ma + ar * (ar + ma) ^ 2 / (1 - ar ^ 2)) * (1 - ar ^ 2) / ar

    return(c(new_ma, new_var))
  }  
  else{
  a = ar + ma
  c = 1 - ar ^ 2
  d = veps / veta / n
  e = ar / c - a / c + ar * d / c
  f = 1 + a ^ 2 / c + d
  g = (a + ar * a ^ 2 / c) * (-1)
  b1 = (-f + sqrt(f ^ 2 - 4 * e * g)) / 2 / e
  b2 = (-f - sqrt(f ^ 2 - 4 * e * g)) / 2 / e
  tb1 = b1 - ar
  tb2 = b2 - ar
  s2b = veta * (a + ar * a ^ 2 / c) / (b1 + ar * b1 ^ 2 / c)

  return(c(tb1, s2b))
  }
}

Sigma_o = function(ar, ma_b, veps, v_b, n){
  block11 = (1 + ar * ma_b) / (ar + ma_b) ^ 2 * cbind(c((1 - ar ^ 2) * (1 + ar * ma_b), -(1 - ar ^ 2) * (1 - ma_b ^ 2)), c(-(1 - ar ^ 2) * (1 - ma_b ^ 2), (1 - ma_b ^ 2) * (1 + ar * ma_b)))
  block22 = 2 * v_b ^ 2
  block33 = 2 * veps ^ 2 / n ^ 2 / (n-1)
  full = matrix(0, nrow = 4, ncol = 4)
  full[1:2,1:2] = block11
  full[3,3] = block22
  full[4,4] = block33
  return(full)
}

Sigma_o_varyingn = function(ar, ma_b, veps, v_b, n_t){
  block11 = (1 + ar * ma_b) / (ar + ma_b) ^ 2 * cbind(c((1 - ar ^ 2) * (1 + ar * ma_b), -(1 - ar ^ 2) * (1 - ma_b ^ 2)), c(-(1 - ar ^ 2) * (1 - ma_b ^ 2), (1 - ma_b ^ 2) * (1 + ar * ma_b)))
  block22 = 2 * v_b ^ 2
  n_t = n_t[n_t != 0]
  n_bar = mean(n_t)
  m_hat = mean(1 / n_t)
  S2_n_inverse = var(1 / n_t)
  avar_sigma_a2 = S2_n_inverse * veps ^ 2 + 2 * veps ^ 2 * m_hat ^ 2 / (n_bar - 1)
  
  
  block33 = avar_sigma_a2
  full = matrix(0, nrow = 4, ncol = 4)
  full[1:2,1:2] = block11
  full[3,3] = block22
  full[4,4] = block33
  return(full)
}

GG2 = function(ar, ma, veps, veta, n, ma_b, v_b){
  dHdl = diag(rep(1,6))
  dHdl[5,5] = 2 * ma * veta
  dHdl[5,6] = 1 + ma ^ 2
  dHdl[6,5] = veta
  dHdl[6,6] = ma
  dHdl_inv = solve(dHdl)
  dHdo = cbind(c(2 * ar * veps / n, -veps / n),c(-2 * ma_b * v_b, -v_b),c(-(1 + ma_b ^ 2), -ma_b),c(1 + ar ^ 2, -ar))
  dHdo = rbind(diag(rep(-1,4)), dHdo)
  return(-dHdl_inv %*% dHdo)
}

wong = function(ar_hat, ma_b_hat, v_b_hat, v_a_hat, theta_free = TRUE){


# Parameters 
theta_b_hat = ma_b_hat
ph_hat = ar_hat
sigma_a2_hat = v_a_hat
sigma_b2_hat = v_b_hat

if (theta_free == FALSE){
  theta_hat = 0
  var_eta_hat = max((1 + theta_b_hat^2) * sigma_b2_hat - (1 + ph_hat ^ 2) * sigma_a2_hat, 0)
  return(c(theta_hat, var_eta_hat))
}

# Initial guesses
aa = theta_b_hat * sigma_b2_hat + ph_hat * sigma_a2_hat
bb = (1 + ph_hat^2) * sigma_a2_hat - (1 + theta_b_hat ^ 2) * sigma_b2_hat
cc = aa

start_ma = 1 / 2 / aa * (-bb - sqrt(bb ^ 2 - 4 * aa * cc))
start_veta = (theta_b_hat * sigma_b2_hat + ph_hat * sigma_a2_hat) / start_ma
if (is.na(start_ma) == FALSE && is.na(start_veta) == FALSE){
 return(c(start_ma,start_veta, is.na(start_ma) == FALSE && is.na(start_veta) == FALSE))}else{
start <- c(theta_b_hat, sigma_b2_hat)


  # Constraints
lower_bounds <- c(-0.9999, 1e-6)
upper_bounds <- c(0.9999, Inf)

# Solve the system
result <- BBoptim(
  par = start,
  fn = equations_arma,
  ph_hat = ph_hat,
  theta_b_hat = theta_b_hat,
  sigma_a2_hat = sigma_a2_hat,
  sigma_b2_hat = sigma_b2_hat,
  lower = lower_bounds,
  upper = upper_bounds,
  quiet = TRUE,
  control = list(trace = 0)
)


theta_hat = result$par[1]
var_eta_hat = result$par[2]
#return(c(theta_hat,var_eta_hat))
return(c(theta_hat,var_eta_hat, is.na(start_ma) == FALSE && is.na(start_veta) == FALSE))}
}

avar = function(phi, theta, var_eps, var_eta, nn, T, sims){
  var_a = var_eps / nn
  b_vec = fwd(ar = phi, ma = theta, veps = var_eps, veta = var_eta, n = nn)
  theta_b = b_vec[1]
  var_b = b_vec[2]
  
  S_o = Sigma_o(ar = phi, ma_b = theta_b, veps = var_eps, v_b = var_b, n = nn)
  G = GG(ar = phi, ma = theta, veps = var_eps, veta = var_eta, n = nn, ma_b = theta_b, v_b = var_b)
  S_l = G %*% S_o %*% t(G)
  
  est_tib = tibble(phi_hat = 0, theta_b_hat = 0, var_b_hat = 0, var_a_hat = 0, theta_hat = 0, var_eta_hat = 0)
  defined_start = 0
  for (sim in 1:sims){
    N = nn * T
    eps = rnorm(N, mean = 0, sd = sqrt(var_eps))
    u = generate_arma(ar = phi, ma = theta, var = var_eta, length = T)
    y = rep(u, each = nn) + eps
    t = rep(1:T, each = nn)
    tib = tibble(day = t, y = y)
    w = tib %>%
      group_by(day) %>%
      summarize(mean = mean(y))
    w = w$mean
    tib$w = rep(w, each = nn)
    tib = tib %>%
      mutate(x = y - w)
    ts_model = arima(w, order = c(1,0,1), include.mean = FALSE)
    phi_hat = ts_model$coef["ar1"]
    theta_b_hat = ts_model$coef["ma1"]
    var_b_hat = ts_model$sigma2
    var_eps_hat = sum(tib$x ^ 2) / T / (nn - 1)
    var_a_hat = var_eps_hat / nn
    
    wong_est = wong(ar_hat = phi_hat, ma_b_hat = theta_b_hat, v_b_hat = var_b_hat, v_a_hat = var_eps_hat/nn)
    

    ###
    var_eta_hat = wong_est[2]
    theta_hat = wong_est[1]
    defined_start[sim] = wong_est[3]
    est_tib = rbind(est_tib, c(phi_hat, theta_b_hat, var_b_hat, var_a_hat, theta_hat, var_eta_hat))
  }
  est_tib = filter(est_tib, phi_hat != 0)
  true_tib = tibble(phi_hat = rep(phi, sims), theta_b_hat = rep(theta_b, sims), var_b_hat = rep(var_b, sims), var_a_hat = rep(var_a, sims), theta_hat = rep(theta, sims), var_eta_hat = rep(var_eta, sims))
  final_tib = sqrt(T) * (est_tib - true_tib)
  return(list(theta_b, var_b, S_o, est_tib, true_tib, final_tib,  S_l,cov(final_tib), defined_start))
}

theoretical_conf_l = function(phi, theta, var_eta, TT, sims, var_eps, nn, alpha = .05){
  var_a = var_eps / nn
  theta_b = fwd(phi, theta, var_eta, var_eps, nn)[1]
  var_b = fwd(phi, theta, var_eta, var_eps, nn)[2]
  S_o = Sigma_o(phi, theta_b, veps = var_eps, v_b = var_b, n = nn)
  H_0 = dHf_dtau0(phi, theta_b, var_eps / 2, var_b)
  H_1 = dHf_dtau1(theta, var_eta)
  GGG = -solve(H_1) %*% H_0
  S_f = GGG %*% S_o %*% t(GGG)
  S_l = S_f[c(1,5,6), c(1,5,6)]
  chi_q = qchisq(1 - alpha, 3)
  chi_sims = 0
  H_solvable = 0
for (sim in 1:sims){
  test_u = arima.sim(model = list(ar = phi, ma = theta), n = TT, sd = sqrt(var_eta))
  eps = rnorm(n = TT * nn, mean = 0, sd = sqrt(var_eps))
  y = rep(test_u, each = nn) + eps
  w = t(matrix(y, nrow = nn)) %*% rep(1/nn, nn)
  x = y - rep(w, each = nn)
  var_eps_hat = sum(x ^ 2 / (nn - 1) / TT)
  var_a_hat = var_eps_hat / nn
  arma_noise = arima(w, order = c(1,0,1), include.mean = FALSE)
  phi_hat = arma_noise$coef["ar1"]
  theta_b_hat = arma_noise$coef["ma1"]
  var_b_hat = arma_noise$sigma2
  wong_est = wong(phi_hat, theta_b_hat, var_b_hat, var_eps_hat / nn)
  theta_hat = wong_est[1]
  var_eta_hat = wong_est[2]
  est_vec = c(phi_hat, theta_hat, var_eta_hat)
  true_vec = c(phi, theta, var_eta)
  S_o2 = S_o[1:3,1:3]
  obs_vec = c(phi_hat, theta_b_hat, var_b_hat)
  obs_true = c(phi, theta_b, var_b)
  true_full = c(phi, theta, var_eta, var_eps, theta_b, var_b)
  est_full = c(phi_hat, theta_hat, var_eta_hat, var_eps_hat, theta_b_hat, var_b_hat)
  # print(true_full)
  # print(est_full)
  chi_stat = as.numeric(TT * t(true_vec - est_vec) %*% solve(S_l) %*% (true_vec - est_vec))
obs_stat = as.numeric(TT * t(obs_true - obs_vec) %*% solve(S_o2) %*% (obs_true - obs_vec))

  chi_sims[sim] = chi_stat < chi_q
  H_solvable[sim] = wong_est[3]
}
return(mean(chi_sims))
}

e_fn = function(ar,mab,sigmab2,sigmaa2){
  return(mab * sigmab2 + ar * sigmaa2)
}

f_fn = function(ar,mab,sigmab2,sigmaa2){
  return(-(1 + mab ^ 2) * sigmab2 + (1 + ar ^ 2) * sigmaa2)
}

dF_fn = function(phi,theta_b, sigma_b2, sigma_e2, nn){
  final = matrix(0, nrow = 6, ncol = 4)
  final[1,1] = 1
  final[2,2] = 1
  final[3,3] = 1
  final[4,4] = 1
  wong_est = wong(ar_hat = phi, ma_b_hat = theta_b, v_b_hat = sigma_b2, v_a_hat = sigma_e2/nn)
  ee = e_fn(phi, theta_b, sigma_b2, sigma_a2)
  ff = f_fn(phi, theta_b, sigma_b2, sigma_a2)
  theta = (-ff - sqrt(ff ^ 2 - 4 * ee ^ 2)) / 2 / ee
  var_eta = (theta_b * sigma_b2 + phi * sigma_a2) / theta
  print(theta)
  print(var_eta)
  theta = wong_est[1]
  var_eta = wong_est[2]
  print(theta)
  print(var_eta)
  
  dedphi = sigma_a2
  dedsa2 = phi
  dedthetab = sigma_b2
  dedsb2 = theta_b
  dfdphi = 2 * phi * sigma_a2
  dfdsa2 = 1 + phi ^ 2
  dfdthetab = -2 * theta_b * sigma_b2 
  dfdsb2 = -(1 + theta_b ^ 2)
  
  final[5,1] = ((-dfdphi - .5 * (ff ^ 2 - 4 * ee ^ 2) ^ (-1 / 2) * (2 * dfdphi * ff - 8 * ee * dedphi)) * 2 * ee + (ff + (ff ^ 2 - 4 * ee ^ 2) ^ (1 / 2)) * 2 * dedphi) / (4 * ee ^ 2)
  final[5,2] = ((-dfdthetab - .5 * (ff ^ 2 - 4 * ee ^ 2) ^ (-1 / 2) * (2 * dfdthetab * ff - 8 * ee * dedthetab)) * 2 * ee + (ff + (ff ^ 2 - 4 * ee ^ 2) ^ (1/2)) * 2 * dedthetab) / (4 * ee ^ 2)
  final[5,3] = ((-dfdsb2 - .5 * (ff ^ 2 - 4 * ee ^ 2) ^ (-1 / 2) * (2 * dfdsb2 * ff - 8 * ee * dedsb2)) * 2 * ee + (ff + (ff ^ 2 - 4 * ee ^ 2) ^ (1/2)) * 2 * dedsb2) / (4 * ee ^ 2)
  final[5,4] = ((-dfdsa2 - .5 * (ff ^ 2 - 4 * ee ^ 2) ^ (-1 / 2) * (2 * dfdsa2 * ff - 8 * ee * dedsa2)) * 2 * ee + (ff + (ff ^ 2 - 4 * ee ^ 2) ^ (1/2)) * 2 * dedsa2) / (4 * ee ^ 2)

  final[6,1] = (sigma_a2 * theta - (theta_b * sigma_b2 + phi * sigma_a2) * final[5,1]) / theta ^ 2
  final[6,2] = (sigma_b2 * theta - (theta_b * sigma_b2 + phi * sigma_a2) * final[5,2]) / theta ^ 2
  final[6,3] = (theta_b * theta - (theta_b * sigma_b2 + phi * sigma_a2) * final[5,3]) / theta ^ 2
  final[6,4] = (phi * theta - (theta_b * sigma_b2 + phi * sigma_a2) * final[5,4]) / theta ^ 2
  return(final)
}

dHf_dtau0 <- function(phi, theta_b, sigma_a2, sigma_b2) {
  
  M <- matrix(0, nrow = 6, ncol = 4)
  
  # Identity block (negative)
  diag(M[1:4, 1:4]) <- -1
  
  # Row 5
  M[5, 1] <-  2 * phi * sigma_a2
  M[5, 2] <- -2 * theta_b * sigma_b2
  M[5, 3] <- -(1 + theta_b^2)
  M[5, 4] <-  (1 + phi^2)
  
  # Row 6
  M[6, 1] <- -sigma_a2
  M[6, 2] <-  -sigma_b2
  M[6, 3] <- -theta_b
  M[6, 4] <- -phi
  
  return(M)
}

dHf_dtau1 <- function(theta, sigma_eta2) {
  
  M <- matrix(0, nrow = 6, ncol = 6)
  
  # Identity block
  diag(M[1:4, 1:4]) <- 1
  
  # Row 5
  M[5, 5] <- 2 * theta * sigma_eta2
  M[5, 6] <- 1 + theta^2
  
  # Row 6
  M[6, 5] <- sigma_eta2
  M[6, 6] <- theta
  
  return(M)
}

theoretical_conf_o = function(phi, theta, var_eta, TT, sims, var_eps, nn, alpha = .05){
  chi_sims = 0
  theta_b = fwd(phi, theta,var_eta, var_eps, nn)[1]
  var_b = fwd(phi, theta,var_eta, var_eps, nn)[2]
  Sigma_inv = Sigma_o(ar = phi, ma_b = theta_b, veps = var_eps, v_b = var_b, n = nn)[1:3,1:3] %>% solve()
  true_vec = c(phi, theta_b, var_b)
  chi_q = qchisq(p = 1- alpha, df = 3)
  for (sim in 1:sims){
    test_u = arima.sim(model = list(ar = phi, ma = theta), sd = sqrt(var_eta), n = TT)
    eps = rnorm(n = TT * nn, mean = 0, sd = sqrt(var_eps))
    y = rep(test_u, each = nn) + eps
    w = t(matrix(y, nrow = nn)) %*% rep(1/nn, nn)
    x = y - rep(w, each = nn)
    var_eps_hat = sum(x ^ 2) / (nn - 1) / TT
    var_a_hat = var_eps_hat / nn
    arma_noise = arima(w, order = c(1,0,1), include.mean = FALSE)
    phi_hat = arma_noise$coef["ar1"]
    theta_b_hat = arma_noise$coef["ma1"]
    var_b_hat = arma_noise$sigma2
    est_vec = c(phi_hat, theta_b_hat, var_b_hat)
    chi_stat = t(est_vec - true_vec) %*% Sigma_inv %*% (est_vec - true_vec) * TT
    chi_sims[sim] = chi_stat < chi_q
  }
  return(mean(chi_sims))
}

no_th_b_est = function(ph, v_b, v_a){
  a = 1
  b = (1 + ph ^ 2) * v_a - v_b
  c = ph ^ 2 * v_a ^ 2
  sol1 = (-b + sqrt(b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c)) / 2
  sol2 = (-b - sqrt(b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c)) / 2
  th1 = ph * v_a / sol1
  th2 = ph * v_a / sol2
  return(list("veta" = c(sol1, sol2), "theta" = c(th1,th2)))
  
}

emp_conf_l = function(phi, theta, var_eta, TT, sims, var_eps, nn, alpha = .05){
  
arman_pars = fwd(ar = phi, ma = theta, veta = var_eta, veps = var_eps, n = nn)

theta_b = arman_pars[1]
var_b = arman_pars[2]
  chi_sims = 0
H_solvable = 0
for (sim in 1:sims){
test_u = arima.sim(model = list(ar = phi, ma = theta), n = TT, sd = sqrt(var_eta))
eps = rnorm(n = TT * nn, mean = 0, sd = sqrt(var_eps))
y = rep(test_u, each = nn) + eps
w = t(matrix(y, nrow = nn)) %*% rep(1/nn, nn)
x = y - rep(w, each = nn)
var_eps_hat = sum(x ^ 2 / (nn - 1) / TT)
var_a_hat = var_eps_hat / nn
arma_noise = arima(w, order = c(1,0,1), include.mean = FALSE)
phi_hat = arma_noise$coef["ar1"]
theta_b_hat = arma_noise$coef["ma1"]
var_b_hat = arma_noise$sigma2

wong_est = wong(phi_hat, theta_b_hat, var_b_hat, var_eps_hat/ nn)
theta_hat = wong_est[1]
var_eta_hat = wong_est[2]
S_o = Sigma_o(phi_hat, theta_b_hat, var_eps_hat, var_b_hat, nn)
H0 = dHf_dtau0(phi, theta_b, var_eps/nn, var_b)
H1 = dHf_dtau1(theta, var_eta)
GGG = -solve(H1) %*% H0
S_f = GGG %*% S_o %*% t(GGG)
S_l = S_f[c(1,5,6), c(1,5,6)]

est_vec = c(phi_hat, theta_hat, var_eta_hat)
true_vec = c(phi, theta, var_eta)
true_full = c(phi, theta, var_eta, var_eps, theta_b, var_b)
est_full = c(phi_hat, theta_hat, var_eta_hat, var_eps_hat, theta_b_hat, var_b_hat)
# print(true_full)
# print(est_full)

chi_stat = as.numeric(TT * t(true_vec - est_vec) %*% solve(S_l) %*% (true_vec - est_vec))

chi_q = qchisq(1 - alpha, 3)
chi_sims[sim] = chi_stat < chi_q
H_solvable[sim] = wong_est[3]

}
return(mean(chi_sims))
}


make_bar <- function(x0, y0, dx, dy, height, color="blue") {
  # vertices of the cuboid
  verts <- rbind(
    c(x0,      y0,      0),
    c(x0+dx,   y0,      0),
    c(x0+dx,   y0+dy,   0),
    c(x0,      y0+dy,   0),
    c(x0,      y0,      height),
    c(x0+dx,   y0,      height),
    c(x0+dx,   y0+dy,   height),
    c(x0,      y0+dy,   height)
  )
  
  # faces (triangles)
  i <- c(0,1,2,  0,2,3,   4,5,6,  4,6,7,   0,1,5,  0,5,4,  1,2,6,  1,6,5,
         2,3,7,  2,7,6,   3,0,4,  3,4,7)
  j <- c(1,2,3,  2,3,0,   5,6,7,  6,7,4,   1,5,4,  5,4,0,  2,6,5,  6,5,1,
         3,7,6,  7,6,2,   0,4,7,  4,7,3)
  k <- c(2,3,0,  3,0,1,   6,7,4,  7,4,5,   5,4,0,  4,0,1,  6,5,1,  5,1,2,
         7,6,2,  6,2,3,   4,7,3,  7,3,0)
  
  list(verts=verts, i=i, j=j, k=k, color=color)
}
plot_ellipsoid = function(name_vec, est_vec, true_vec, Sigma, alpha = .05, df = 3, ngrid = 40){
  est_matrix = matrix(NA, nrow = 1, ncol = 3)
  r2 = qchisq(1 - alpha, df = df)
  eig = eigen(Sigma)
  A = eig$vectors %*% diag(sqrt(eig$values * r2))
  
  # Sphere parameterization
  u = seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = ngrid)
  v = seq(0, pi, length.out = ngrid)
  x = outer(cos(u), sin(v))
  y = outer(sin(u), sin(v))
  z = outer(rep(1, length(u)), cos(v))
  
  ellipsoid = A %*% rbind(as.vector(x), as.vector(y), as.vector(z))
  x_e = matrix(ellipsoid[1, ] + est_vec[1], ngrid, ngrid)
  y_e = matrix(ellipsoid[2, ] + est_vec[2], ngrid, ngrid)
  z_e = matrix(ellipsoid[3, ] + est_vec[3], ngrid, ngrid)
  
  # --- Step 4: generate plot ---
  p <- plot_ly() %>%
    add_surface(
      x = x_e, y = y_e, z = z_e,
      opacity = 0.5,
      name = paste0(round(100*(1-alpha)), "% confidence ellipsoid"),
      showscale = FALSE
    ) %>%
    add_markers(
      x = est_matrix[,1],
      y = est_matrix[,2],
      z = est_matrix[,3],
      #color = ~inside,
      colors = c("red", "green"),
      marker = list(size = 3),
      name = "Simulations (green = inside)"
    ) %>%
    add_markers(
      x = true_vec[1], y = true_vec[2], z = true_vec[3],
      marker = list(size = 5, color = "blue"),
      name = "True value"
    ) %>%
    layout(
      scene = list(
        xaxis = list(title = name_vec[1]),
        yaxis = list(title = name_vec[2]),
        zaxis = list(title = name_vec[3])
      ),
      title = paste0(round(100*(1-alpha)), "% Confidence Ellipsoid with Simulations")
    )
  
print(p)
tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".html")

htmlwidgets::saveWidget(p, tmp, selfcontained = TRUE)

utils::browseURL(tmp)
}
plot_3d_bars <- function(df, xcol="ar", ycol="ma", zcol="conf",
                         dx=NULL, dy=NULL) {
  
  # rename to standard
  df <- df %>% rename(x = !!xcol, y = !!ycol, z = !!zcol)
  
  # Determine bar widths (dx, dy) automatically from grid spacing
  if(is.null(dx)){
    dx <- min(diff(sort(unique(df$x))))
  }
  if(is.null(dy)){
    dy <- min(diff(sort(unique(df$y))))
  }
  
  plt <- plot_ly()
  
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(df))) {
    bar <- make_bar(df$x[k], df$y[k], dx, dy, df$z[k],
                    color = "steelblue")
    
    plt <- plt %>% add_mesh(
      x = bar$verts[,1],
      y = bar$verts[,2],
      z = bar$verts[,3],
      i = bar$i,
      j = bar$j,
      k = bar$k,
      opacity = 0.9,
      color = bar$color,
      showscale = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  plt %>% layout(
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title="ar"),
      yaxis = list(title="ma"),
      zaxis = list(title="empirical frequency")
    )
  )
}

sim_arman_reg = function(n_t, beta, X_f, var_eps, ar, ma, veta){
  T = length(n_t)
  N = sum(n_t)
  u = arima.sim(model = list(ar = ar, ma = ma), sd = sqrt(veta), n = T)
  eps = rnorm(n = N, sd = sqrt(var_eps), mean = 0)
  X_t = f_Xt(n_t)
  y = as.vector(as.matrix(X_f) %*% beta + X_t %*% u + eps)
  df = tibble(t = as.vector(X_t %*% 1:T), y = y, u = as.vector(X_t %*% u)) %>% cbind(X_f)
  return(df)
}

f_V = function(n_t){

T = length(n_t)
V_list = list()
vlistcount = 1
for (nt in 1:T){
  nrow = n_t[nt]
  if (nrow != 0){
    c_space = rep(1, nrow)
    null_basis = Null((c_space))
    ortho_basis <- qr.Q(qr(null_basis))
    V_list[[vlistcount]] = ortho_basis
    vlistcount = vlistcount + 1
  }
  
}
V = bdiag(V_list)
VtV_list = Map(function(a, b) a %*% t(b), V_list, V_list)
VtV = bdiag(VtV_list)
VtV = Matrix(VtV, sparse = TRUE)
V = Matrix(V, sparse = TRUE)
return(V)
}


f_u_hat_fixedn = function(n, T, residuals, Gamma, var_epsilon){
X_t = f_Xt(rep(n,T))
V = f_V(rep(n,T))

G_eigen = eigen(Gamma)
G_evec = G_eigen$vectors
G_eval = G_eigen$values
X_t = Matrix(X_t, sparse = TRUE)
L = diag(G_eval) %>% Matrix(sparse = TRUE)
D_inv = diag(1 / (n * G_eval + var_epsilon))
D_inv = Matrix(D_inv, sparse = TRUE)
# VVt = V %*% t(V) / var_eps_hat
u1 = G_evec %*% L %*% D_inv %*% t(G_evec) %*% t(X_t) %*% residuals
# u2 = G_hat %*% t(X_t) %*% VVt %*% residuals(me) / var_eps_hat

return(u1)
}

f_u_hat = function(n_t, residuals, Gamma, var_epsilon){
T = length(n_t)
N = sum(n_t)
X_t = f_Xt(n_t)
sqN = diag(sqrt(n_t))
NGN_eigen = eigen(sqN %*% Gamma %*% sqN)

NGN_evec = NGN_eigen$vectors
NGN_eval = NGN_eigen$values
X_t = Matrix(X_t, sparse = TRUE)
L = diag(NGN_eval + var_eps_hat) %>% Matrix(sparse = TRUE)

# VVt = V %*% t(V) / var_eps_hat
u1 = Gamma %*% sqN %*% NGN_evec %*% solve(L) %*%  t(NGN_evec) %*% sqN 
u1 = u1[n_t != 0, n_t != 0]
u1 = u1 %*%  residuals[n_t != 0]
# u2 = G_hat %*% t(X_t) %*% VVt %*% residuals(me) / var_eps_hat

return(u1 %>% as.vector())
}
arman_gls_em = function(sims, T, ar, ma, veta, veps, beta, alpha = .05){

ff_initial = "y ~ 1 + t + x"
ff_update = "less_u_hat ~ 1 + t + x"
lambda_n = 50
xi2captured_track_gls = c()
chi_beta_track1_gls = c()
chi_beta_track2_gls = c()
chi_beta_track3_gls = c()

for (sim in 1:sims){
sim_start = Sys.time()
n_t = rpois(n = T, lambda = lambda_n) + 2
X_t = f_Xt_sparse(n_t)
N = diag(n_t)


var_eps = veps
var_eta = veta
phi = ar
theta = ma

fwd_est = fwd(phi, theta, var_eta, var_eps, (mean(n_t[n_t != 0]^(-1)))^(-1))
theta_b = fwd_est[1]
var_b = fwd_est[2]
var_a = var_eps * mean(n_t[n_t != 0]^(-1))

X_f = tibble(intercept = 1, day = as.vector(X_t %*% (1:T)), x = rbinom(n = sum(n_t), size = 1, prob = .5))
X_f_m = as.matrix(X_f)


test = sim_arman_reg(n_t, 
                     beta, 
                     X_f , 
                     var_eps , 
                     ar , 
                     ma , 
                     veta )
ggplot(data = test) + 
  geom_point(mapping = aes(x = t, y = y))
lm_initial = lm(test, formula = ff_initial)
l1 = logLik(lm_initial) %>% as.numeric()
test$resid = residuals(lm_initial)
test$resid_initial = test$resid
df_w = test %>%
  group_by(t) %>%
  summarize(w = mean(resid), S2 = var(resid), n = n())
df_w_initial = df_w
arma_w = arima(df_w$w, order = c(1,0,1), include.mean = FALSE)
phi_hat = arma_w$coef["ar1"]
theta_b_hat = arma_w$coef["ma1"]
var_b_hat = arma_w$sigma2
var_eps_hat = sum((df_w$n - 1) * df_w$S2) / (sum(n_t) - sum(n_t != 0))
var_a_hat = var_eps_hat * mean((n_t[n_t != 0])^{-1})
wong_est = wong(phi_hat, theta_b_hat, var_b_hat, var_a_hat)
theta_hat = wong_est[1]
var_eta_hat = wong_est[2]
G_hat = fG(size = T, eta_variance = var_eta_hat, ar = phi_hat, ma = theta_hat)
u_hat = f_u_hat(n_t, df_w$w, G_hat, var_eps_hat)
l2 = -1/2 * (T * log(2 * pi) + (determinant(G_hat, logarithm = TRUE)$modulus %>% as.numeric()) + as.vector(t(u_hat) %*% solve(G_hat) %*% u_hat))
l_new = l2 + l1
l_old = l_new + 3
l1_track = l1
l2_track = l2
l_track = l_old
phi_track = phi_hat
theta_track = theta_hat
var_eta_track = var_eta_hat
var_eps_track = var_eps_hat

while (abs(l_old-l_new) > 2){
  l_old = l_new
  NGN_eigen = eigen(N^(1/2) %*% G_hat %*% N ^ (1/2))
NGN_evec = NGN_eigen$vectors
NGN_eval = NGN_eigen$values
L = diag(NGN_eval)
V = f_V(n_t)
  test$less_u_hat = test$y - as.vector(X_t %*% u_hat)
  lm_new = lm(test, formula = ff_update)
  l1 = lm_new %>% logLik() %>% as.numeric()

beta_hat1 = t(X_f_m) %*% X_t %*% diag(sqrt(1/n_t)) %*% NGN_evec %*% diag(sqrt(1 / (NGN_eval + var_eps_hat)))
beta_hat1 = beta_hat1 %*% t(beta_hat1)
beta_hat2 = t(X_f_m) %*% V
beta_hat2 = beta_hat2 %*% t(beta_hat2) / var_eps_hat
beta_hat = solve(beta_hat1 + beta_hat2) 
beta_hat3 = t(X_f_m) %*% X_t %*% diag(sqrt(1/n_t)) %*% NGN_evec %*% diag(1 / (NGN_eval + var_eps_hat)) %*% t(NGN_evec) %*% diag(sqrt(1/n_t)) %*% t(X_t) %*% test$y

beta_hat4 = t(V) %*% test$y
beta_hat4 = t(X_f_m) %*% V %*% beta_hat4 / var_eps_hat
beta_hat = beta_hat %*% (beta_hat3 + beta_hat4)
test$resid = as.vector(test$y - X_f_m %*% beta_hat)

df_w = test %>%
  group_by(t) %>%
  summarize(w = mean(resid), S2 = var(resid), n = n(), u = mean(u))
df_w$w = df_w$w 
arma_w = arima(df_w$w, order = c(1,0,1), include.mean = FALSE)
phi_hat = arma_w$coef["ar1"]
theta_b_hat = arma_w$coef["ma1"]
var_b_hat = arma_w$sigma2
var_eps_hat = sum((df_w$n - 1) * df_w$S2) / (sum(n_t) - sum(n_t != 0))

var_a_hat = var_eps_hat * mean((n_t[n_t != 0])^{-1})

wong_est = wong(phi_hat, theta_b_hat, var_b_hat, var_a_hat)

theta_hat = wong_est[1]
var_eta_hat = wong_est[2]

G_hat = fG(size = T, eta_variance = var_eta_hat, ar = phi_hat, ma = theta_hat)

u_hat = f_u_hat(n_t, df_w$w, G_hat, var_eps_hat)
l2 = -1/2 * (T * log(2 * pi) + (determinant(G_hat, logarithm = TRUE)$modulus %>% as.numeric()) + as.vector(t(u_hat) %*% solve(G_hat) %*% u_hat))

l_new = l2 + l1

l1_track = l1_track %>% append(l1)
l2_track = l2_track %>% append(l2)
l_track = l_track %>% append(l_new)
phi_track = phi_track %>% append(phi_hat)
theta_track = theta_track %>% append(theta_hat)
var_eta_track = var_eta_track %>% append(var_eta_hat)
var_eps_track = var_eps_track %>% append(var_eps_hat)
}

S_o = Sigma_o_varyingn(phi_hat, theta_b_hat, var_eps_hat, var_b_hat, n_t)


var_eta_est = var_eta_hat

H1 = dHf_dtau1(theta_hat, var_eta_hat)
H0 = dHf_dtau0(phi_hat, theta_b_hat, var_a_hat, var_b_hat)
GGG = -solve(H1) %*% H0
S_f = GGG %*% S_o %*% t(GGG)
S_l = S_f[c(1,5,6),c(1,5,6)]
S_l_plot = S_l / T
vec_est = c(phi_hat, theta_hat, var_eta_hat)
vec_true = c(phi, theta, var_eta)
vec_name = c("phi", "theta", "var_eta")

#plot_ellipsoid(name_vec = vec_name, est_vec = vec_est, true_vec = vec_true, Sigma = S_l_plot)
cutoff = qchisq(p = .95, df = 3)
chistat = t(vec_est - vec_true) %*% solve(S_l_plot) %*% (vec_est - vec_true)
cutoff
chistat
xi2chi2 = chistat
xi2captured_track_gls = xi2captured_track_gls %>% append(xi2chi2)

beta_cutoff = qchisq(p = 1 - alpha, df = length(beta))

XftXf= (t(X_f_m) %*% X_f_m)
XftXf_inv = solve(XftXf)






Sigma_beta3_term1 = t(X_f_m) %*% X_t %*% diag(sqrt(1 / n_t)) %*% NGN_evec %*% diag(sqrt(1/(NGN_eval + var_eps_hat)))

Sigma_beta3_term1 = Sigma_beta3_term1 %*% t(Sigma_beta3_term1)

Sigma_beta3_term2 = t(X_f_m) %*% V 
Sigma_beta3_term2 = Sigma_beta3_term2 %*% t(Sigma_beta3_term2) / var_eps_hat

Sigma_beta3 = solve(Sigma_beta3_term1 + Sigma_beta3_term2)



chistat_beta3 = t(beta_hat - beta) %*% solve(Sigma_beta3) %*% (beta_hat - beta)

chistat_beta3 = chistat_beta3 %>% as.numeric()

chi_beta_track3_gls = chi_beta_track3_gls %>% append(chistat_beta3)


sim_end = Sys.time()
print(sim_end - sim_start)

}

# xi1 = mean(chi_beta_track3_gls < beta_cutoff)
# xi2 = mean(xi2captured_track_gls < cutoff)

return(list(l1_conf = mean(chi_beta_track3_gls < cutoff),l2_conf = mean(xi2captured_track_gls < cutoff), l = l_track, l1 = l1_track, l2 = l2_track, phi = phi_track, theta = theta_track, var_eta = var_eta_track, var_eps = var_eps_track))
}


G_theta = function(ar, ma, veta, ma_b, v_b, veps, m_hat){
  dH_dtau0 = matrix(0, nrow = 3, ncol = 4)
  dH_dtau0[1,4] = -1
  dH_dtau0[2,1] = -1
  dH_dtau0[3,1] = -2 * ar * veps * m_hat
  dH_dtau0[3,2] = 2 * ma_b * v_b
  dH_dtau0[3,3] = 1 + ma_b^2
  dH_dtau0[3,4] = 1 + ar^2 * m_hat
  dH_dtau1 = diag(c(1,1,-1))
  G = -solve(dH_dtau1) %*% dH_dtau0
  return(G)
}
```

#Showing bias introduced in Modugno of fitting ARMA-Process with AR(1)
##Estimating phi
```{r}
set.seed(123)
ar_bias_df = tibble(phi = rep(seq(-.9, .9, by = .2), each = 1), log2 = 1) %>%
  mutate(var_a = 2 ^ log2)

emp_exp_ar_vs_arma = function(phi, v_a, TT, sims){
  phi_mean_ar = c()
  phi_mean_arma = c()
  veta_mean_ar = c()
  veta_mean_arma = c()
  for (sim in 1:sims){
    uu = arima.sim(model = list(ar = phi), sd = 1, n = TT)
    aa = rnorm(n = TT, mean = 0, sd = sqrt(v_a))
    ww = uu + aa
    ar_model = arima(ww, order = c(1,0,0), include.mean = FALSE)
    arma_model = arima(ww, order = c(1,0,1), include.mean = FALSE)
    phi_hat_ar = ar_model$coef["ar1"]
    phi_hat_arma = arma_model$coef["ar1"]
    veta_hat_ar = ar_model$sigma2
    veta_hat_arma = arma_model$sigma2
    phi_mean_ar = append(phi_mean_ar, phi_hat_ar)
    phi_mean_arma = append(phi_mean_arma, phi_hat_arma)
    veta_mean_ar = append(veta_mean_ar, veta_hat_ar)
    veta_mean_arma = append(veta_mean_arma, veta_hat_arma)
  }
    return(c(phi_mean_ar = phi_mean_ar %>% mean(), 
             phi_mean_arma = phi_mean_arma %>% mean(),
             veta_mean_ar = veta_mean_ar %>% mean(),
             veta_mean_arma = veta_mean_arma %>% mean()))
}

ar_bias_df = ar_bias_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(means = emp_exp_ar_vs_arma(phi, var_a, 1000,100) %>% list())

ar_bias_df <- ar_bias_df %>%
  ungroup() %>%                 # important after rowwise()
  unnest_wider(means)

ar_bias_df = ar_bias_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(true_var = fwd(ar = phi, ma = 0, veta = 1, veps = var_a, n = 1)[2]) %>%
  ungroup()


```

```{r}
set.seed(123)

# ---- 1. Long-format points (3 per row) ----
df_long <- ar_bias_df %>%
  mutate(
    true_phi = phi,
    row_id = row_number()
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(phi, phi_mean_ar, phi_mean_arma),
    names_to = "source",

  )


ggplot(data = df_long) + 
  geom_point(mapping = aes(x = true_phi, y = z, colour = source)) +

  filter(source != "phi") %>%

# ---- 3. Plot ----

      phi_mean_arma = "green4"
    ),
    type = "scatter3d",
    mode = "lines",
    line = list(width = 3),
    opacity = 0.6,
    showlegend = FALSE
  ) %>%
  
  layout(
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(
        title = "φ (true)",
        range = c(-1, 1)
      ),
      yaxis = list(
        title = "log₂ var ratio",
        range = c(-5, 5)
      ),
      zaxis = list(title = "value"),
      aspectmode = "manual",
      aspectratio = list(x = 1, y = 2.5, z = 1),
      camera = list(eye = list(x = 1.5, y = 1.5, z = 1.2))
    ),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Source"))
  )
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
```

```{r}
phi = .9

var_eta = 1
var_eps = 1

u = arima.sim(model = list(ar = phi, ma = theta), n = T, sd = sqrt(var_eta))


eps = rnorm(n = T * n_t, mean = 0, sd = sqrt(var_eps))
df = tibble(t = rep(1:T, each = n_t), ts = rep(u, each = n_t), eps = eps)

ceiling = max(df$ts + df$eps)
floor = min(df$ts + df$eps)

ggplot() + 
  geom_point(mapping = aes(x = 1:T, y = u), col = "blue") +
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)

# --- User inputs ----
T <- 1000      # sample size (replace with your T)
alpha <- 0.05
p <- 3

# true parameter vector (center of ellipsoid)
theta0 <- c(phi = 0.5, theta = .1, var_eta = 1)

# Asymptotic covariance matrix of sqrt(T)*(hat - true)
Sigma <- Sigma_o(.5,.1,1,1,5)[1:3,1:3]

# sanity check: symmetric positive definite
if(!all.equal(Sigma, t(Sigma))) stop("Sigma must be symmetric.")
e <- eigen(Sigma, symmetric = TRUE)
if(any(e$values <= 0)) stop("Sigma must be positive definite (all eigenvalues > 0).")

# chi-square cutoff
chi2cut <- qchisq(1 - alpha, df = p)   # e.g. 7.8147 for p=3, alpha=0.05

# The ellipsoid in parameter space satisfies:
# (x - theta0)' Sigma^{-1} (x - theta0) <= chi2cut / T
scale_factor <- chi2cut / T

# radii along principal axes:
radii <- sqrt(scale_factor * e$values)   # length-3 vector
rot <- e$vectors                          # columns are eigenvectors

# build a unit sphere then transform to ellipsoid
n <- 50
theta_seq <- seq(0, pi, length.out = n)
phi_seq   <- seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = n)
xs <- outer(sin(theta_seq), cos(phi_seq))
ys <- outer(sin(theta_seq), sin(phi_seq))
zs <- outer(cos(theta_seq), rep(1, n))

# transform sphere points -> ellipsoid points
X <- numeric()
Y <- numeric()
Z <- numeric()
for(i in seq_len(n)){
  for(j in seq_len(n)){
    v <- c(xs[i,j], ys[i,j], zs[i,j])
    pt <- theta0 + rot %*% (radii * v)
    X <- c(X, pt[1])
    Y <- c(Y, pt[2])
    Z <- c(Z, pt[3])
  }
}

# Optional: simulate some sqrt(T)*(hat - true) draws and convert to hat values
set.seed(2026)
m <- 200
# simulate asymptotic distribution for sqrt(T)*(hat - true)
draws_sqrtT <- mvrnorm(m, mu = rep(0,3), Sigma = Sigma)
draws_hat <- t( t(draws_sqrtT) / sqrt(T) ) + matrix(theta0, nrow = m, ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

# function to test membership
inside_ellipsoid <- function(xvec){
  # xvec is length-3 vector (hat)
  val <- t(xvec - theta0) %*% solve(Sigma) %*% (xvec - theta0)
  as.numeric(val) <= chi2cut / T
}
# compute for simulated points
inside_flag <- apply(draws_hat, 1, inside_ellipsoid)

# Plot with plotly (mesh3d for ellipsoid surface, scatter for points)
ellipsoid_mesh <- list(
  x = X, y = Y, z = Z,
  i = NULL, j = NULL, k = NULL
)
# plotly's mesh3d can be given unstructured triangles; easiest is to use `alphashape` packages,
# but for simplicity we use scatter3d of the surface points with opacity to suggest surface.

p <- plot_ly() %>%
  add_markers(x = draws_hat[!inside_flag,1], y = draws_hat[!inside_flag,2], z = draws_hat[!inside_flag,3],
              marker = list(size = 3, symbol = 'circle'), name = "outside (sim)") %>%
  add_markers(x = draws_hat[inside_flag,1], y = draws_hat[inside_flag,2], z = draws_hat[inside_flag,3],
              marker = list(size = 3, symbol = 'circle', color = 'green'), name = "inside (sim)") %>%
  add_markers(x = theta0[1], y = theta0[2], z = theta0[3],
              marker = list(size = 6, color = 'red'), name = "true value (center)") %>%
  add_markers(x = mean(draws_hat[,1]), y = mean(draws_hat[,2]), z = mean(draws_hat[,3]),
              marker = list(size = 6, color = 'black'), name = "avg sim hat") %>%
  add_trace(x = X, y = Y, z = Z, type = 'scatter3d', mode = 'markers',
            marker = list(size = 2, opacity = 0.45), name = "ellipsoid surface (approx)") %>%
  layout(scene = list(xaxis = list(title="phi"),
                      yaxis = list(title="theta"),
                      zaxis = list(title="var_eta")),
         title = paste0(100*(1-alpha), "% CI ellipsoid centered at true value (T=", T, ")"))

p


```

#CI estimate plot
```{r}
set.seed(123)
test_phi = .9
test_ma = -.6
test_veta = 1
test_veps = 1000
test_n = 150
test_T = 1000
alpha = .05
test_mab = fwd(test_phi,test_ma, test_veta, test_veps, test_n)
u = arima.sim(model = list(ar = test_phi, ma = test_ma), n = test_T, sd = test_veta)
eps = rnorm(n = test_n * test_T, sd = test_veps %>% sqrt())
X_t = bdiag(replicate(test_T, rep(1, test_n), simplify = FALSE)) %>% as.matrix
y = X_t %*% u + eps
w = test_n ^ (-1) * t(X_t) %*% y
x = y - X_t %*% w
var_eps_hat = sum(x ^ 2) / test_T / (test_n - 1)
arima_noise = arima(w, order = c(1,0,1))
phi_hat = arima_noise$coef["ar1"]
theta_b_hat = arima_noise$coef["ma1"]
var_b_hat = arima_noise$sigma2
wong_est = wong(phi_hat, theta_b_hat, var_b_hat, var_eps_hat / test_n)
theta_hat = wong_est[1]
var_eta_hat = wong_est[2]
test_So = Sigma_o(ar = phi_hat, ma_b = theta_b_hat, veps = var_eps_hat, v_b = var_b_hat, n = test_n)
test_G = GG2(ar = phi_hat, ma = theta_hat, veps = var_eps_hat, veta = var_eta_hat, n = test_n, ma_b = theta_b_hat, v_b = var_b_hat)
test_finalcov = test_G %*% test_So %*% t(test_G)
test_latentcov = test_finalcov[c(1,5,6), c(1,5,6)]



# ----- Inputs -----
T <- test_T                # sample size
p <- 3
alpha <- 0.05              # 95% CI
theta_hat_vec <- c(phi_hat, theta_hat, var_eta_hat)   # estimated parameters
theta_true_vec <- c(test_phi, test_ma, test_veta)  # true parameters
Sigma <- test_latentcov    # asymptotic covariance matrix of sqrt(T)*(hat - true)

# ----- Checks -----
stopifnot(all.equal(Sigma, t(Sigma)))                 # symmetric
e <- eigen(Sigma, symmetric = TRUE)
if(any(e$values <= 0)) stop("Sigma must be positive definite (all eigenvalues > 0).")

# ----- Ellipsoid geometry -----
chi2cut <- qchisq(1 - alpha, df = p)
scale_factor <- chi2cut / T

radii <- sqrt(scale_factor * e$values)
rot <- e$vectors  # columns = eigenvectors

# ----- Build unit sphere -----
n <- 60
theta_seq <- seq(0, pi, length.out = n)
phi_seq   <- seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = n)

xs <- outer(sin(theta_seq), cos(phi_seq))
ys <- outer(sin(theta_seq), sin(phi_seq))
zs <- outer(cos(theta_seq), rep(1, n))

# ----- Transform sphere to ellipsoid -----
X <- Y <- Z <- numeric()
for(i in seq_len(n)){
  for(j in seq_len(n)){
    v <- c(xs[i,j], ys[i,j], zs[i,j])
    pt <- theta_hat_vec + rot %*% (radii * v)
    X <- c(X, pt[1])
    Y <- c(Y, pt[2])
    Z <- c(Z, pt[3])
  }
}

# ----- Plot -----
p <- plot_ly() %>%
  add_trace(
    x = X, y = Y, z = Z,
    type = 'scatter3d', mode = 'markers',
    marker = list(size = 2, color = 'blue', opacity = 0.4),
    name = paste0(round((1 - alpha) * 100), "% CI ellipsoid")
  ) %>%
  add_markers(
    x = theta_hat_vec[1], y = theta_hat_vec[2], z = theta_hat_vec[3],
    marker = list(size = 6, color = 'black', symbol = 'diamond'),
    name = "Parameter estimates (center)"
  ) %>%
  add_markers(
    x = theta_true_vec[1], y = theta_true_vec[2], z = theta_true_vec[3],
    marker = list(size = 6, color = 'red', symbol = 'cross'),
    name = "True parameter values"
  ) %>%
  layout(
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = "phi"),
      yaxis = list(title = "theta"),
      zaxis = list(title = "var_eta")
    ),
    title = paste0(round((1 - alpha) * 100), "% CI ellipsoid around estimates (T=", T, ")")
  )
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
arma_noise3d = tibble(ar = rep(seq(-.9,.9,by = .1), each = (19 * 9)), 
                      ma = seq(-.9,.9,by = .1) %>% rep(times = 19 * 9),
                      var_ratio = (2 ^ seq(-4,4,by = 1)) %>% rep(each = 19) %>% rep(times = 19))

arma_noise3d = mutate(rowwise(arma_noise3d), theta_b = fwd(ar = ar, ma = ma, veta = var_ratio, veps = 1, n = 1)[1], var_b = fwd(ar = ar, ma = ma, veta = var_ratio, veps = 1, n = 1)[2])
arma_noise3d = mutate(arma_noise3d, log_var = log(var_ratio, base = 2))

plot_ly(
  data = arma_noise3d,
  x = ~ar, y = ~ma, z = ~log_var,
  color = ~theta_b,
  colors = colorRamp(c("blue", "yellow")),   # blue-yellow color scale
  type = "scatter3d",
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(size = 5, opacity = 0.8)
) %>%
  layout(
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = "x1"),
      yaxis = list(title = "x2"),
      zaxis = list(title = "x3")
    ),
    title = "3D Plot with Color by Dependent Variable"
  )
arma_noise3d$var_b[!is.finite(arma_noise3d$var_b)] <- NA

plot_ly(
  data = arma_noise3d,
  x = ~ar, y = ~ma, z = ~log_var,
  color = ~var_b,
  colors = colorRamp(c("blue", "yellow")),   # blue-yellow color scale
  type = "scatter3d",
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(size = 5, opacity = 0.8)
) %>%
  layout(
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = "x1"),
      yaxis = list(title = "x2"),
      zaxis = list(title = "x3")
    ),
    title = "3D Plot with Color by Dependent Variable"
  )
```

#INAR simulation
```{r}
set.seed(123)
l = 50
inar = rpois(n = 1, lambda = l)
inar_length = 100
alpha = .3
beta = .8
for (i in 1:(inar_length - 1)){
  t1 = rbinom(n = 1, size = inar[i], prob = alpha)
  t2 = rpois(n=1, lambda = l)
  t3 = rbinom(n = 1, size = inar[i], prob = beta)
  inar = append(inar, (t1 + t2 - t3))
}

ggplot() + 
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = 1:inar_length, y = inar)) + 
  xlab("Time") + 
  ylab("Sample Size") + 
  ggtitle("")+
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16)
  )

ggsave("output/inar.png", height = 7, width = 7)

png("output/inar_acf.png", width = 7, height = 7, units = "in", res = 300)
par(mar = c(4,4,2,1), cex.lab = 1.5,  # axis labels ("Lag", "ACF")
  cex.axis = 1.3)  # tick labels (numbers))  # bottom, left, top, right margins
acf(inar)
dev.off()



```

##Test wong with and without restricting theta
```{r}
set.seed(123)
arman_inf = function(phi, theta, var_eta, var_eps, T, n, alpha = .05, ngrid = 40){
  
est_matrix = matrix(NA, nrow = 1, ncol = 3)
theta_b = fwd(phi, theta, var_eta, var_eps, n)[1]
var_b = fwd(phi, theta, var_eta, var_eps, n)[2]
var_a = var_eps / n


uu = arima.sim(model = list(ar = phi, ma = theta), n = T, sd = sqrt(var_eta))
eps = rnorm(n = n * T, mean = 0, sd = 1)
t = rep(1:T, each = n)

test_tib = tibble(t = t, u = rep(uu, each = n), eps = eps, y = u + eps)

daily_test = test_tib %>%
  group_by(t) %>%
  summarize(mean = mean(y), S2 = sd(y) ^ 2)

var_eps_hat = mean(daily_test$S2)
var_a_hat = var_eps_hat / n
arima_b = arima(daily_test$mean, order = c(1,0,1), include.mean = FALSE)
phi_hat = arima_b$coef["ar1"]
theta_b_hat = arima_b$coef["ma1"]
var_b_hat = arima_b$sigma2

S_o = Sigma_o(ar = phi_hat, ma_b = theta_b_hat, veps = var_eps_hat, v_b = var_b_hat, n = n)

#######First CI

S_l_plotly = S_o[1:3,1:3] / T
true_vec = c(phi, theta_b, var_b)
est_vec = c(phi_hat, theta_b_hat, var_b_hat)
name_vec = c("phi", "theta_b", "var_b")


plot_ellipsoid(name_vec, est_vec, true_vec, S_l_plotly)

conf_region_2d(theta_hat = est_vec[1:2], theta_true = true_vec[1:2], Sigma = S_l_plotly[1:2,1:2]) %>% print()

  radius <- qchisq(1 - alpha, df = 2)
  eig <- eigen(S_l_plotly[1:2,1:2])
  angles <- seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 400)
ellipse <- t(
  c(phi_hat, theta_b_hat) +
    sqrt(radius) *
    eig$vectors %*%
    diag(sqrt(eig$values)) %*%
    rbind(cos(angles), sin(angles))
)
ellipse_df <- as.data.frame(ellipse)
colnames(ellipse_df) <- c("phi", "theta_b")
theta_df <- data.frame(
  phi = vec_est[1],
  theta_b = vec_est[2]
)
plot1 = ggplot(ellipse_df, aes(x = phi, y = theta_b)) +
  geom_path(linewidth = 1)  +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    x = (expression(phi)),
    y = paste(expression(theta),"_b"),
    title = paste0(round(100 * (1 - alpha)), "% Confidence Region")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_point(data = tibble(x = phi, y = theta_b), mapping = aes(x = x, y = y), col = "blue") +
  geom_point(data = tibble(x = phi_hat, y = theta_b_hat), mapping = aes(x = x, y = y), col = "red")
  
plot2 = ggplot(ellipse_df, aes(x = phi, y = theta_b)) +
  geom_path(linewidth = 1)  +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    x = (expression(phi)),
    y = paste(expression(theta),"_b"),
    title = paste0(round(100 * (1 - alpha)), "% Confidence Region")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_point(data = tibble(x = phi, y = theta_b), mapping = aes(x = x, y = y), col = "blue") +
  geom_point(data = tibble(x = phi_hat, y = theta_b_hat), mapping = aes(x = x, y = y), col = "red") + 
  xlim(c(-1,1)) + 
  ylim(c(-1,1)) + 
  geom_line(data = tibble(x = c(-1,1), y = c(1,-1)), mapping = aes(x,y)) + 
  geom_line(data = tibble(x = c(-1,1), y = c(0,0)), mapping = aes(x,y)) + 
  geom_line(data = tibble(x = c(0,0), y = c(1,-1)), mapping = aes(x,y))

  vec_est = c(var_b_est, var_a_est)
  qq = qnorm(p = alpha / 2)
  radius <- qchisq(1 - alpha, df = 2)
  eig <- eigen(S_o / T)
  angles <- seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 400)
ellipse <- t(
  vec_est +
    sqrt(radius) *
    eig$vectors %*%
    diag(sqrt(eig$values)) %*%
    rbind(cos(angles), sin(angles))
)

ellipse_df <- as.data.frame(ellipse)

colnames(ellipse_df) <- c("var_b", "var_a")
theta_df <- data.frame(
  var_b = vec_est[1],
  var_a = vec_est[2]
)
  plot1 = ggplot(ellipse_df, aes(x = var_b, y = var_a)) +
  geom_path(linewidth = 1)  +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    x = paste(expression(sigma),"_b^2"),
    y = paste(expression(sigma),"_a^2"),
    title = paste0(round(100 * (1 - alpha)), "% Confidence Region")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() + 
  geom_point(data = tibble(x = var_b, y = var_a), mapping = aes(x = x, y = y), col = "blue") + 
    geom_point(data = tibble(x = var_b_est, y = var_a_est), mapping = aes(x = x, y = y), col = "red")
  # xlim(c(-1,1)) 
print(plot1)
  dev.flush()        # flush graphics output
  dev.hold(FALSE)  
  GG = matrix(0, nrow = 3, ncol = 2)
  GG[1,1] = 1
  GG[2,2] = 1
  GG[3,1] = 1
  GG[3,2] = -1
  S_f = GG %*% S_o %*% t(GG)
  S_f = S_f[2:3,2:3] / T
  vec_est = c(var_a_est, var_eta_est)
  qq = qnorm(p = alpha / 2)
  radius <- qchisq(1 - alpha, df = 2)
  eig <- eigen(S_f)
  angles <- seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 400)
ellipse <- t(
  vec_est +
    sqrt(radius) *
    eig$vectors %*%
    diag(sqrt(eig$values)) %*%
    rbind(cos(angles), sin(angles))
)

ellipse_df <- as.data.frame(ellipse)

colnames(ellipse_df) <- c("var_a", "var_eta")
theta_df <- data.frame(
  var_a = vec_est[1],
  var_eta = vec_est[2]
)
  plot1 = ggplot(ellipse_df, aes(x = var_a, y = var_eta)) +
  geom_path(linewidth = 1)  +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    x = paste(expression(sigma),"_a^2"),
    y = paste(expression(sigma),"_eta^2"),
    title = paste0(round(100 * (1 - alpha)), "% Confidence Region")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() + 
  geom_point(data = tibble(x = var_a, y = var_eta), mapping = aes(x = x, y = y), col = "blue") + 
   geom_point(data = tibble(x = var_a_est, y = var_eta_est), mapping = aes(x = x, y = y), col = "red") 
  # xlim(c(-1,1)) 
print(plot1)
dev.flush()        # flush graphics output
  dev.hold(FALSE)  
}else if(ans == 1){
  choices = no_th_b_est(ph = phi_hat, v_b = var_b_hat, v_a = var_a_hat)
  print(choices)
  ans = readline("Which solution do you want to use?
           [1] first entries of each
           [2] second entries of each")
  ans = as.integer(ans)
  var_eta_hat = choices$veta[ans]
  theta_hat = choices$theta[ans]
  # print(theta_hat)
  # print(var_eta_hat)
  H1 = matrix(0, nrow = 3, ncol = 3)
  H0 = matrix(0, nrow = 3, ncol = 3)
  H1[1,1] = 1
  H0[1,1] = -1
  H0[2,1] = -theta_hat / phi_hat ^ 2
  H1[2,2] = 1 / phi_hat
  H1[2,3] = var_a_hat / var_eta_hat ^ 2
  H0[3,1] = var_eta_hat * 2 * phi_hat * var_a_hat + 2 * phi_hat * var_a_hat ^ 2
  H1[3,3] = 2 * var_eta_hat + (1 + phi_hat ^ 2) * var_a_hat - var_b_hat
  H0[2,3] = -1 / var_eta_hat
  H0[3,2] = -var_eta_hat
  H0[3,3] = var_eta_hat * (1 + phi_hat ^ 2) + 2 * phi_hat ^ 2 * var_a_hat
  # print(H0)
  # print(H1)

  GG = -solve(H1) %*% H0
  # print(GG)
  S_l = GG %*% S_o %*% t(GG)
  # print(S_l)
  S_plot = S_l / T
  
  vec_name = c("phi", "theta", "var_eta")
  vec_est = c(phi_hat, theta_hat, var_eta_hat)
  vec_true = c(phi, theta, var_eta)
  plot_ellipsoid(name_vec = vec_name, est_vec = vec_est, true_vec = vec_true, Sigma = S_plot)
}
}
```

#Illustrate shortcomings of fitting ARMA with covariates
```{r}
set.seed(123)
T = 100
X_f_tib = tibble(intercept = X_f[,1], slope = X_f[,2], x = X_f[,3])
n_t = summarize(group_by(X_f_tib,slope),n = n())$n
beta = c(50,-.01,1)
var_eps = 1
ar = .5
ma = .2
veta = 1
test = sim_arman_reg(n_t, beta, X_f_tib, var_eps, ar, ma, veta)
df_armacov = test %>%
  group_by(t) %>%
  summarize(ts = mean(y), x = mean(x))
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)

T = 1000
lambda_n = 100
sims = 100
estimates = c()
zscores = c()
variances = c()
for (sim in 1:sims){
n_t = rpois(n = T, lambda = lambda_n) 
X_t = f_Xt_sparse(n_t)
beta = c(43,-.001,.25) 
var_eps = 100
var_eta = 1
phi = 0.5
theta = 0.5

fwd_est = fwd(phi, theta, var_eta, var_eps, (mean(n_t[n_t != 0]^(-1)))^(-1))
theta_b = fwd_est[1]
var_b = fwd_est[2]
var_a = var_eps * mean(n_t[n_t != 0]^(-1))

X_f = tibble(intercept = 1, day = as.vector(X_t %*% (1:T)), x = rbinom(n = sum(n_t), size = 1, prob = .5))
var_eps = var_eps
ar = phi 
ma = theta 
veta = var_eta
test = sim_arman_reg(n_t, 
                     beta, 
                     X_f , 
                     var_eps , 
                     ar , 
                     ma , 
                     veta )



df_armacov = test %>%
  group_by(t) %>%
  summarize( n = n(), x = mean(x), y = mean(y))

covariate_matrix = matrix(0, nrow = nrow(df_armacov), ncol = 3)
covariate_matrix[,1] = 1
covariate_matrix[,2] = df_armacov$t
covariate_matrix[,3] = df_armacov$x

armacov = arima(df_armacov$y, order = c(1,0,1), xreg = covariate_matrix[,2:3], include.mean = TRUE)

sim_est = armacov$coef
sim_se = armacov$var.coef %>% diag() %>% sqrt()
sim_z = sim_est / sim_se
zscores = cbind(zscores, sim_z)
estimates = cbind(estimates, armacov$coef)
variance = armacov$sigma2
variances = append(variances, variance)
}

rowMeans(estimates)
hist(variances)
rowMeans(2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(zscores))) < .05)

ts_cov_df = tibble(Parameter = c("phi", 
                            "theta", 
                            "Intercept", 
                            "Slope",
                            "Covariate"),
                   `True Value` = c(phi, theta, beta[1], beta[2], beta[3]),
                   `Estimate Mean` = rowMeans(estimates), 
                   `Sig. Freq.` = rowMeans(2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(zscores))) < .05)
)


print(xtable(ts_cov_df, digits = c(0, 0, 3, 3, 3)), include.rownames = FALSE, file = "output/arma_cov_df.txt")

print(xtable(head(test %>% dplyr::select(t,x,y))), include.rownames = FALSE, file = "output/arma_cov_head.txt")

print(xtable(head(df_armacov)), include.rownames = FALSE, file = "output/arma_cov_head_daily.txt")

ggplot(data = test) + 
  geom_point(mapping = aes(x = t, y = y))

ggplot(data = df_armacov) + 
  geom_point(mapping = aes(x = t, y = y))
```

#constant inverse moment deterministic mean
```{r}
set.seed(123)
c = 1/2
T = 299
k_vec = 2:(T+1)
n_vec = c()
p_vec = c()
mean_vec = c()
for (k_t in k_vec){
  p_t = (1-c) * k_t / (k_t - 1)
  n_t = rbinom(n = 1, size = 1, prob = p_t) * (k_t - 1) + 1
  n_vec = append(n_vec, n_t)
  p_vec = append(p_vec, p_t)
  mean = c * k_t
  mean_vec = append(mean_vec, mean)
}



reps = rnorm(n = sum(n_vec), mean = 0, sd = sqrt(10))
ttt = rep(1:T, times = n_vec)
tibtib = tibble(t = ttt, eps = reps)
ttib = tibtib %>%
  group_by(t) %>%
  summarize(a = mean(eps),
            S2 = var(eps),
            n = n())


ggplot() + 
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = 2:(T+1), y = n_vec)) + 
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = 2:(T + 1), y = mean_vec), col = "red") +
  xlab("t") + 
  ylab("Sample Size")
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16)
  )
ggsave("output/constant_inverse_n.png", width = 7, height = 7, units = "in")

png("output/constant_inverse_acf_n.png", width = 7, height = 7, units = "in", res = 300)
acf(n_vec)
dev.off()

ggplot() + 
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = 2:(T), y = n_vec[2:length(n_vec)] - n_vec[1:(length(n_vec) - 1)])) + 
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = 2:(T), y = mean_vec[2:length(n_vec)] - mean_vec[1:(length(n_vec) - 1)]), col = "red") +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16)
  )
ggsave("output/constant_inverse_n_diff.png", width = 7, height = 7, units = "in")

png("output/constant_inverse_acf_n_diff.png", width = 7, height = 7, units = "in", res = 300)
acf(n_vec[2:length(n_vec)] - n_vec[1:(length(n_vec) - 1)])
dev.off()


ggplot() + 
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = 2:(T+1), y = 1/n_vec)) + 
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = 2:(T+1), y = c), col = "red") +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16)
  )
ggsave("output/constant_inverse_n_inv.png", width = 7, height = 7, units = "in")

png("output/constant_inverse_acf_n_inv.png", width = 7, height = 7, units = "in", res = 300)
acf(1/n_vec)
dev.off()

ggplot() + 
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = 2:(T+1), y = ttib$a)) +
  xlab("t") + 
  ylab("Aggregate Noise")
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16)
  )
ggsave("output/constant_inverse_a.png", width = 7, height = 7, units = "in")

png("output/constant_inverse_acf.png", width = 7, height = 7, units = "in", res = 300)
acf(ttib$a)
dev.off()

acf(n_vec[2:length(n_vec)] - n_vec[1:(length(n_vec) - 1)])
```

```{r}
}
```

```{r}
  group_by(t) %>%
  summarize(y_bar = mean(y), w = mean(resid), S2 = var(resid), n = n())



df_w_initial = df_w
arma_w = arima(df_w$w, order = c(1,0,0), include.mean = FALSE)
phi_hat = arma_w$coef["ar1"]
theta_b_hat = 0
var_b_hat = arma_w$sigma2

var_eps_hat = sum((df_w$n - 1) * df_w$S2) / (sum(n_t) - sum(n_t != 0))
print(var_eps_hat)
var_a_hat = var_eps_hat * mean((n_t[n_t != 0])^{-1})
wong_est = wong(phi_hat, theta_b_hat, var_b_hat, var_a_hat, theta_free = TRUE)
theta_hat = wong_est[1]
var_eta_hat = wong_est[2]
G_hat = fG(size = T, eta_variance = var_eta_hat, ar = phi_hat, ma = theta_hat)
#u_hat = f_u_hat(n_t, df_w$w, G_hat, var_eps_hat)
#l2 = -1/2 * (T * log(2 * pi) + (determinant(G_hat, logarithm = TRUE)$modulus %>% as.numeric()) + as.vector(t(u_hat) %*% solve(G_hat) %*% u_hat))

test$y_bar = as.vector(X_t %*% df_w$y_bar)
Sigma_bar = G_hat + (var_eps_hat * N_inv)

l2_new = -T / 2 * log(2 * pi) -  sum(log(diag(chol(Sigma_bar)))) - 1 / 2 * t(df_w$y_bar - N_inv %*% t(X_t) %*% X_f_m %*% beta_hat) %*% chol2inv(chol(Sigma_bar)) %*% (df_w$y_bar - N_inv %*% t(X_t) %*% X_f_m %*% beta_hat)

l2_new = l2_new %>% as.numeric()
var_eps_hat
l1_new = -sum(n_t) / 2 * log(2 * pi * var_eps_hat) - 1 / 2  /var_eps_hat * sum((test$y - test$y_bar)^2) 
l1_new = l1_new %>% as.numeric
print(l1_new)
l_new = l1_new + l2_new

l1_track = l1_track %>% append(l1_new)
l2_track = l2_track %>% append(l2_new)
l_track = l_track %>% append(l_new)
phi_track = phi_track %>% append(phi_hat)
theta_track = theta_track %>% append(theta_hat)
var_eta_track = var_eta_track %>% append(var_eta_hat)
var_eps_track = var_eps_track %>% append(var_eps_hat)

while (abs(l_old-l_new) > 1e-3){
  l_old = l_new
  NGN_eigen = eigen(N^(1/2) %*% G_hat %*% N ^ (1/2))
NGN_evec = NGN_eigen$vectors
NGN_eval = NGN_eigen$values
L = diag(NGN_eval)
V = f_V(n_t)


beta_hat1 = t(X_f_m) %*% X_t %*% diag(sqrt(1/n_t)) %*% NGN_evec %*% diag(sqrt(1 / (NGN_eval + var_eps_hat)))
beta_hat1 = beta_hat1 %*% t(beta_hat1)
beta_hat2 = t(X_f_m) %*% V
beta_hat2 = beta_hat2 %*% t(beta_hat2) / var_eps_hat
beta_hat = solve(beta_hat1 + beta_hat2) 
beta_hat3 = t(X_f_m) %*% X_t %*% diag(sqrt(1/n_t)) %*% NGN_evec %*% diag(1 / (NGN_eval + var_eps_hat)) %*% t(NGN_evec) %*% diag(sqrt(1/n_t)) %*% t(X_t) %*% test$y

beta_hat4 = t(V) %*% test$y
beta_hat4 = t(X_f_m) %*% V %*% beta_hat4 / var_eps_hat
beta_hat = beta_hat %*% (beta_hat3 + beta_hat4)
test$resid = as.vector(test$y - X_f_m %*% beta_hat)

df_w = test %>%
  group_by(t) %>%
  summarize(y_bar = mean(y), w = mean(resid), S2 = var(resid), n = n(), u = mean(u))



arma_w = arima(df_w$w, order = c(1,0,0), include.mean = FALSE)
phi_hat = arma_w$coef["ar1"]
theta_b_hat = 0
var_b_hat = arma_w$sigma2
var_eps_hat = sum((df_w$n - 1) * df_w$S2) / (sum(n_t) - sum(n_t != 0))
print(var_eps_hat)
var_a_hat = var_eps_hat * mean((n_t[n_t != 0])^{-1})

wong_est = wong(phi_hat, theta_b_hat, var_b_hat, var_a_hat, theta_free = TRUE)

theta_hat = wong_est[1]
var_eta_hat = wong_est[2]

G_hat = fG(size = T, eta_variance = var_eta_hat, ar = phi_hat, ma = theta_hat)
Sigma_bar = G_hat + (var_eps_hat * N_inv)

# u_hat = f_u_hat(n_t, df_w$w, G_hat, var_eps_hat)
l2_new = -T / 2 * log(2 * pi) - sum(log(diag(chol(Sigma_bar)))) - 1 / 2 * t(df_w$y_bar - N_inv %*% t(X_t) %*% X_f_m %*% beta_hat) %*% chol2inv(chol(Sigma_bar)) %*% (df_w$y_bar - N_inv %*% t(X_t) %*% X_f_m %*% beta_hat)
l2_new = l2_new %>% as.numeric()

l1_new = -sum(n_t) / 2 * log(2 * pi * var_eps_hat) - 1 / 2  /var_eps_hat * sum((test$y - test$y_bar)^2) 
l1_new = l1_new %>% as.numeric()
print(l1_new)
l_new = l1_new + l2_new



l1_track = l1_track %>% append(l1_new)
l2_track = l2_track %>% append(l2_new)
l_track = l_track %>% append(l_new)
phi_track = phi_track %>% append(phi_hat)
theta_track = theta_track %>% append(theta_hat)
var_eta_track = var_eta_track %>% append(var_eta_hat)
var_eps_track = var_eps_track %>% append(var_eps_hat)
}

S_o = diag(c(1-phi_hat^2, 2 * var_b_hat^2, 2 * var_eps_hat ^ 2 * T / (sum(n_t)-T)))

m_hat = mean(1/n_t)

dH_d0 = matrix(0, nrow = 4, ncol = 3)
dH_d0[1,3] = -1
dH_d0[2,1] = -1
dH_d0[3,2] = 1
dH_d0[3,1] = -2 * phi_hat * var_eps_hat * m_hat
dH_d0[3,3] = -(1 + phi_hat^2) * m_hat
dH_d0[4,1] = -var_eps_hat * m_hat
dH_d0[4,3] = -phi_hat * m_hat

dH_d1 = matrix(0, nrow = 4, ncol = 4)
dH_d1[1,1] = 1
dH_d1[2,2] = 1
dH_d1[3,3] = -2 * theta_hat * var_eta_hat
dH_d1[3,4] = -(1 + theta_hat^2)
dH_d1[4,3] = var_eta_hat
dH_d1[4,4] = theta_hat

GGG = -solve(dH_d1) %*% dH_d0
S_f = GGG %*% S_o %*% t(GGG)

# 
Sigma <- S_f[2:3,2:3] / T  # 2x2 covariance matrix estimate
xi_true <- c(phi, theta)   # true parameters
xi_hat  <- c(phi_hat, theta_hat) # estimated parameters
alpha <- 0.05
# 
# # ---- Compute chi-squared cutoff for 2d ----
df <- 2
chi2_cutoff <- qchisq(1 - alpha, df)
# 
# # ---- Generate ellipse ----
# # Eigen-decomposition of Sigma
eig <- eigen(Sigma)
angles <- seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 100)
circle <- cbind(cos(angles), sin(angles))  # unit circle points
# scale circle to ellipse
ellipse <- t(eig$vectors %*% diag(sqrt(eig$values * chi2_cutoff)) %*% t(circle))
# shift to center at theta_hat
ellipse[,1] <- ellipse[,1] + xi_hat[1]
ellipse[,2] <- ellipse[,2] + xi_hat[2]

# ---- Plot ----
pdf("output/sim_mab_restricted.pdf", width = 7, height = 7)
plot(ellipse, type = "l", col = "blue", lwd = 2,
     xlab = expression(phi), ylab = expression(theta),
     ylim = c(0,1),
     asp = 1, main = "")
points(xi_hat[1], xi_hat[2], pch = 19, col = "red")
text(xi_hat[1], xi_hat[2], labels = "Estimate", pos = 4, col = "red")
points(xi_true[1], xi_true[2], pch = 19, col = "red")
text(xi_true[1], xi_true[2], labels = "True", pos = 4, col = "red")
grid()
dev.off()


# ---- 1D chi-squared cutoff ----
chi2_cutoff_1d <- qchisq(1 - alpha, df = 1)

# ---- Confidence interval for phi ----
var_phi <- S_f[2,2] / T
half_length <- sqrt(chi2_cutoff_1d * var_phi)

phi_lower <- xi_hat[1] - half_length
phi_upper <- xi_hat[1] + half_length
pdf("output/single_dim_mab_restricted.pdf", height = 7, width = 7)

plot(NA, xlim = c(phi_lower, phi_upper),
     ylim = range(c(0, -.1, .1)),
     xlab = expression(phi), ylab = expression(theta[b]),
     asp = 1, main = "")

# horizontal line at theta_b = 0
abline(h = 0, col = "black", lty = 2)

# confidence interval segment
segments(phi_lower, 0, phi_upper, 0, col = "blue", lwd = 3)

# estimated point (projected onto theta_b = 0)
points(xi_hat[1], 0, pch = 19, col = "red")
text(xi_hat[1], 0.01, labels = "Estimate", pos = 4, col = "red")

# true value
points(xi_true[1], xi_true[2], pch = 19, col = "darkgreen")
text(xi_true[1], .01, labels = "True", pos = 4, col = "darkgreen")

grid()
dev.off()
```

#innovations ARMA(1,1)
```{r}
set.seed(123)
phi = .5
theta = .5
var_eta = 1
T = 100
r = 1 + (phi + theta) ^ 2 / (1 - phi ^ 2)
x_hat = 0
test_u = arima.sim(model = list(ar = phi, ma = theta), n = T, sd = var_eta %>% sqrt())
thetat1 = theta / r

for (t in 1:T){
  x_hat_new = phi * test_u[t] + thetat1[t] * (test_u[t] - x_hat[t])
  x_hat = x_hat %>% append(x_hat_new)
  r_new = 1 + theta^2 - theta^2 / r[t]
  r = r %>% append(r_new)
  theta_new = theta / r[t]
  thetat1 = thetat1 %>% append(theta_new)
}

ggplot() + 
  geom_point(mapping = aes(x = 1:T, y = test_u), col = "blue") + 
  geom_point(mapping = aes(x = 1:T, y = x_hat[1:T]), col = "lightblue")

ggplot() + 
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = 1:20, y = r[1:20])) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16) 
  )+ 
      xlab("t") + 
      ylab(expression(r[t]))

ggsave("output/r_t.pdf", width = 7, height = 7)

ggplot() + 
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = 1:20, y = thetat1[1:20])) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = theta, col = "red") + 
  xlab("t") + 
  ylab(expression(theta[t])) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16)
  )

ggsave("output/theta_t1.pdf", width = 7, height = 7)
```

#modugno_defense
```{r}
set.seed(123)
T = 1000
phi = .9
theta = 0
n_t = 5
X_t = f_Xt(rep(5,T))
var_eta = 1
var_eps = 1

beta = c(5,-.01, 2)

u = arima.sim(model = list(ar = phi, ma = theta), n = T, sd = sqrt(var_eta))


eps = rnorm(n = T * n_t, mean = 0, sd = sqrt(var_eps))
df = tibble(t = rep(1:T, each = n_t), ts = rep(u, each = n_t), eps = eps)
beta = c(5,-.01, 2)
i_x = rbinom(n = T * n_t, size = 1, prob = .5)
X_f = cbind(1, rep(1:T, each = n_t), i_x)
df$x = i_x
df$y = X_f %*% beta + df$ts + df$eps
df$y = as.vector(df$y)
df$no_u = df$y - rep(u, each = 5)
df_daily = df %>%
  group_by(t) %>%
  summarize(a = mean(eps))

ylim = max(abs(df$y))

ggplot(data = df) + 
  geom_point(mapping = aes(x = t, y = y, col = as.factor(x))) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none") + 
  xlab("Time") + 
  ylab("Observation") +
  ylim(c(-ylim,ylim))
ggsave("output/modugno_observed.pdf", width = 10, height = 6)
lm_init = lm(df, formula = "y ~ 1 + t + x")

ggplot(data = df) + 
  geom_point(mapping = aes(x = t, y = y - ts, col = as.factor(x))) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none") + 
  xlab("Time") + 
  ylab("Observation") +
  ylim(c(-ylim,ylim))
ggsave("output/modugno_observed_nou.pdf", width = 10, height = 6)
ggplot(data = df) + 
  geom_point(mapping = aes(x = t, y = eps)) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none") + 
  xlab("Time") + 
  ylab("Noise")
```

```{r}

df$resid_init = lm_init$residuals
df_daily  = df %>%
  group_by(t) %>%
  summarize(arman = mean(resid_init), S2 = var(resid_init))

var_eps_hat = mean(df_daily$S2)
arman = arima(df_daily$arman, order = c(1,0,1), include.mean = FALSE)
phi_hat = arman$coef["ar1"]
theta_b_hat = arman$coef["ma1"]
var_b_hat = arman$sigma2

n_t = rep(5, T)
X_f_m = matrix(0, nrow = 5000, ncol = 3)
X_f_m[,1] = 1
X_f_m[,2] = rep(1:T, each = 5)
X_f_m[,3] = df$x
count = 5
phi_track = phi_hat
theta_track = theta_hat
var_eta_track = var_eta_hat 
var_eps_track = var_eps_hat
beta0_track = lm_init$coefficients[1]
beta1_track = lm_init$coefficients[2]
beta2_track = lm_init$coefficients[3]
for (i in 1:count){
  G_hat = fG(size = T, eta_variance = var_eta_hat, ar = phi_hat, ma = theta_hat) 
N = diag(rep(5, T))
  NGN_eigen = eigen(N^(1/2) %*% G_hat %*% N ^ (1/2))
NGN_evec = NGN_eigen$vectors
NGN_eval = NGN_eigen$values
L = diag(NGN_eval)
V = f_V(rep(5,T))


beta_hat1 = t(X_f_m) %*% X_t %*% diag(sqrt(1/n_t)) %*% NGN_evec %*% diag(sqrt(1 / (NGN_eval + var_eps_hat)))
beta_hat1 = beta_hat1 %*% t(beta_hat1)
beta_hat2 = t(X_f_m) %*% V
beta_hat2 = beta_hat2 %*% t(beta_hat2) / var_eps_hat
beta_hat = solve(beta_hat1 + beta_hat2) 
beta_hat3 = t(X_f_m) %*% X_t %*% diag(sqrt(1/n_t)) %*% NGN_evec %*% diag(1 / (NGN_eval + var_eps_hat)) %*% t(NGN_evec) %*% diag(sqrt(1/n_t)) %*% t(X_t) %*% df$y

beta_hat4 = t(V) %*% df$y
beta_hat4 = t(X_f_m) %*% V %*% beta_hat4 / var_eps_hat
beta_hat = beta_hat %*% (beta_hat3 + beta_hat4)
df$resid = as.vector(df$y - X_f_m %*% beta_hat)

df_w = df %>%
  group_by(t) %>%
  summarize(y_bar = mean(y), w = mean(resid), S2 = var(resid), n = n(), u = mean(u))



arma_w = arima(df_w$w, order = c(1,0,1), include.mean = FALSE)
phi_hat = arma_w$coef["ar1"]
theta_b_hat = arma_w$coef["ma1"]
var_b_hat = arma_w$sigma2
var_eps_hat = sum((df_w$n - 1) * df_w$S2) / (sum(n_t) - sum(n_t != 0))

var_a_hat = var_eps_hat * mean((n_t[n_t != 0])^{-1})

wong_est = wong(phi_hat, theta_b_hat, var_b_hat, var_a_hat, theta_free = FALSE)

theta_hat = wong_est[1]
var_eta_hat = wong_est[2]

G_hat = fG(size = T, eta_variance = var_eta_hat, ar = phi_hat, ma = theta_hat)
Sigma_bar = G_hat + (var_eps_hat * N_inv)

# u_hat = f_u_hat(n_t, df_w$w, G_hat, var_eps_hat)






phi_track = phi_track %>% append(phi_hat)
theta_track = theta_track %>% append(theta_hat)
var_eta_track = var_eta_track %>% append(var_eta_hat)
var_eps_track = var_eps_track %>% append(var_eps_hat)
beta0_track = beta0_track %>% append(beta_hat[1])
beta1_track = beta1_track %>% append(beta_hat[2])
beta2_track = beta2_track %>% append(beta_hat[3])
}
```

```{r}
est_tab = function(params, true_vals, est_vals, suffix){
# Optional: round for readability
true_vals <- round(true_vals, 6)
est_vals  <- round(est_vals, 6)

# Build LaTeX lines
lines <- c(
  "\\begin{tabular}{lcccccc}",
  "\\toprule",
  paste("&", paste(params, collapse = " & "), "\\\\"),
  "\\midrule",
  paste("True &", paste(true_vals, collapse = " & "), "\\\\"),
  "\\midrule",
  paste("Est. &", paste(est_vals, collapse = " & "), "\\\\"),
  "\\bottomrule",
  "\\end{tabular}"
)

# Write to file
writeLines(lines, paste("output/remarcs", suffix,".tex", sep = ""))
}
```

```{r}

simulate_inar1 <- function(n, alpha, lambda, x0 = 0) {
  x <- integer(n)
  x[1] <- x0
  
  for (t in 2:n) {
    thinned <- rbinom(1, size = x[t-1], prob = alpha)
    innov   <- rpois(1, lambda)
    x[t] <- thinned + innov
  }
  
  return(x)
}

# Example
set.seed(123)
n_t <- simulate_inar1(n = 100, alpha = 0.5, lambda = lambda)
eps = rnorm(n = sum(n_t), mean = 0, sd = 1)
graph_df = tibble(t = rep(1:100, times = n_t), eps = eps)
graph_df_t = graph_df %>%
  group_by(t) %>%
  summarize(a = mean(eps), n = n())

ggplot(data = graph_df_t) + 
  geom_point(mapping = aes(x = t, y = n)) + 
  xlab("t") + 
  ylab("Sample Size")
ggsave("output/inar_n.pdf")

ggplot(data = graph_df) + 
  geom_point(mapping = aes(x = t, y = eps)) + 
  xlab("t") + 
  ylab("Individual Noise")
ggsave("output/inar_eps.pdf")

ggplot(data = graph_df_t) + 
  geom_point(mapping = aes(x = t, y = a)) + 
  xlab("t") + 
  ylab("Aggregate Noise")
ggsave("output/inar_a.pdf")
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
c = 1/2
T = 199
k_vec = 2:(T+1)
n_vec = c()
p_vec = c()
mean_vec = c()
for (k_t in k_vec){
  p_t = (1-c) * k_t / (k_t - 1)
  n_t = rbinom(n = 1, size = 1, prob = p_t) * (k_t - 1) + 1
  n_vec = append(n_vec, n_t)
  p_vec = append(p_vec, p_t)
  mean = c * k_t
  mean_vec = append(mean_vec, mean)
}



reps = rnorm(n = sum(n_vec), mean = 0, sd = 1)
ttt = rep(1:T, times = n_vec)
tibtib = tibble(t = ttt, eps = reps)
ttib = tibtib %>%
  group_by(t) %>%
  summarize(a = mean(eps),
            S2 = var(eps),
            n = n())


ggplot() + 
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = 2:(T+1), y = n_vec)) + 
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = 2:(T + 1), y = mean_vec), col = "red") +
  xlab("t") + 
  ylab("Sample Size")
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16)
  )
  
ggsave("output/ns_n.pdf")




ggplot(data = tibtib) + 
  geom_point(mapping = aes(x = t, y = eps))+
  xlab("t") + 
  ylab("Individual Noise")
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16)
  )
ggsave(ggsave("output/ns_eps.pdf"))

ggplot() + 
  geom_point(mapping = aes(x = 2:(T+1), y = ttib$a)) +
  xlab("t") + 
  ylab("Aggregate Noise")
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16)
  )
  ggsave("output/ns_a.pdf")

var(ttib$a)
```
